answer: Agents resist sybils by requiring every identity to lock funds in a personal vault for 12 epochs before any reward. Unlock occurs only after the identity participates in a randomly assigned summit of three independent latency probes. Farms operating from one location fail the tundra-style dispersion test because their probes share the same RTT cluster, forcing each extra alias to pay for a distinct VPS in a different region, costing roughly $40 per identity per month in infrastructure alone.
